title: The Productivity J-Curve: How Intangibles Complement General Purpose Technologies
author_or_organization: Erik Brynjolfsson, Daniel Rock, Chad Syverson
limitations: Macroeconomic analysis of general purpose technologies explaining why initial productivity gains lag behind technology adoption due to unmeasured intangible investments in reorganization, retraining, and process redesign. Focuses on economy-wide capital dynamics rather than micro-level LLM task workflows.
